title: THE INBOUND LINE GIVES THE RING LETTER ROOM
why: The critic on the v36.77 picture (screen 37): the ring letter badge sat inside the words on the inbound line (extract b inbound read as extract(b)inbound). The landed line already had two spaces either side; the inbound line now does too. Drawing only. Watch: the ring letter reads as the ring name in both party windows.
now: The inbound extraction line has room around the ring letter badge.

edits.replacement: var _exS=holding?extractNowLine(_exL,G.shipHold):('EXTRACT  '+_exL+'  INBOUND  '+Math.ceil(G.beaconT)+'s');   // v36.xx (cw-xcountplate3): two spaces either side of the ring letter, as the landed line has, so its badge has room (the critic read 'extract(b)inbound')
